profile.headline: Software Developer @ U.S. Department of Labor | Full-Stack Development, Software System Analysis
profile.summary: Software Developer at the U.S. Department of Labor. I build and maintain full-stack applications using C#, .NET, TypeScript, and SQL. I work on Agile teams and can quickly jump into existing projects to deliver practical, user-focused solutions. Previously held a DoD TS/SCI clearance and can obtain it again.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Full-Stack Development Across Multiple Agile Projects – Contributed to two separate Agile projects, one focused on front-end functionality using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, and another emphasizing backend 
development with PL/SQL (Oracle 19c) and .NET Framework.
• Software System Analysis & Design – Conducted requirements analysis and designed software solutions aligned with the Department of Labor's strategic goals. Led Agile story clarification and produced UML-compliant design models within project deadlines.
• Rapid Onboarding & Immediate Impact – Joined projects in later stages, quickly understood complex systems, and began contributing effectively, demonstrating strong adaptability and problem-solving skills.
• Application Development & Maintenance – Developed and tested software solutions adhering to BLS and industry standards, ensuring timely delivery of Agile sprint goals. Implemented updates for legacy systems, optimizing performance and ensuring smooth integration.
• Database Optimization & Management – Designed and optimized PL/SQL queries to enhance database performance, ensure data integrity, and support mission-critical applications.
• Version Control & CI/CD Pipelines – Utilized GitLab for source code management, implemented branching strategies, and set up CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment.
• Software Testing & Quality Assurance – Developed automated test scripts, executed integration testing, and maintained CI/CD pipelines to enhance system reliability.
• Collaboration & Professional Development – Work cross-functionally across teams, contribute to Agile discussions, and continuously enhance skills through training and professional development initiatives.
